run_show_interior_samples: run the script to visualize interior SDF samples from an NPZ file in a 3D window
run_read_sdf_samples_into_ram: run deep_sdf.data.read_sdf_samples_into_ram to load SDF samples from an NPZ file into memory
run_extract_xyz_neg_points: run the script to extract negative interior point coordinates from SDF sample data
run_pangolin_3d_window: run the script to create a Pangolin 3D window with a camera for point cloud visualization
run_opengl_draw_arrays: run the script to render interior sample points as a point cloud using OpenGL draw arrays
